create_hta_config: create an HtaConfig instance that loads default and user-provided JSON config files
get_config_value: get a configuration value by dot-path from an HtaConfig instance with optional default
show_config: print the full merged configuration dictionary as formatted JSON to stdout
get_default_paths: get the list of default config file paths for trace analyzer customization
get_test_data_path: get the file system path to a named test dataset under tests/data
